title: I Asked ChatGPT to Get Me a Job as FAST as Possible
description:
Bada bing. Bada boom. What does ChatGPT know about getting a job? Nothing. Zip. Zilch. 

But. 

Using the combined intelligence of every living being in the solar system we found a better answer. I summoned every ant and made them spill their secrets. How do they make it look so easy? Who employs them? 

Then I gathered all of the blue whales and they told too. Knew they were snitches. Noah's ark who?I have tried the AI applying sites. They suck.
